dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Two questions: Have you got a moment? And if so, would you like to see a magic trick?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Consider it... a rehearsal. Or simply a little light entertainment to lift the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Which deck of cards shall I go with.... Ah yes, this one suits the occasion!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: The battles ahead are not gonna be easy. Look me in the eyes, and answer me this: Are you worried?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Well... If magic is all about achieving the impossible, right before people's very eyes... Don't you think the best magician in the land might stand a chance of pulling that off even outside of a magic show?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: What do you say? Are you ready to team up with the Great Magician Lyney, and see if we can't perform some miracles out there?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I'm sure Freminet would love this book collection. He's someone who really sees the truth in fairytales, and believes in the world of childhood wonder they're set in.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I do understand the way he thinks, but...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: ...The fairytale of childhood is nothing but a distant memory to me now.
